InnerMethod.description: The method an analysis evaluated, at the version actually run.

version.description: Method version run by this engine.

achieved.description: Output of the method at the solution, in the output's units.

inner_method.description: The method evaluated, at the version run.

inner_value.description:
`value` of the inner method's result at the solution. Its schema is the output schema
of the method named at `/inner_method/id` (`x-fairmark-output-of`).

iterations.description: Evaluations after the two bracket ends.

residual.description: `achieved − target`; its absolute value is at most the tolerance.

solution.description: Value of the variable at which the output meets the target, in the variable's units.

solved_input.description:
Input of the inner method at the solution (the variable written as a decimal string).
Running the inner method on it reproduces `inner_value` and its full explain. Its schema
is the input schema of the method named at `/inner_method/id`
(`x-fairmark-input-of`).

tolerance.description: Tolerance applied, in the output's units.
